title: RateLimiter has no synchronization — concurrent use crashes the process
description: Allow reads and writes rl.clients and mutates state.Count/state.WindowStart with no lock, and Reset swaps the map out from under it. Concurrent calls trip Go's map-write detector causing fatal error. Concurrent state.Count++ loses updates, allowing clients to exceed maxPerWindow.

title: clients map grows without bound
description: Entries are only ever added, never evicted. Client keys from external input or long-tail traffic grow the map forever; expired windows keep entries alive indefinitely. Only Reset() clears entries but also wipes every live limit.

title: Doc comment claims a sliding window; code implements a fixed window
description: Line 13 says 'within a sliding time window', but lines 43–46 reset counter wholesale once windowDuration elapses — a fixed window. Callers get up to 2*maxPerWindow requests in a single windowDuration, doubling the intended burst ceiling.
